goal.insight: Show how the Fed funds rate trajectory over 2021-2024 aligns temporally with currency depreciation and sovereign rating downgrades across the 8 emerging markets, making the transmission chain visually traceable
Visually compare the 8 countries along their external-debt-to-GDP ratios and currency depreciation magnitudes to highlight which economies appear most exposed
Emphasize the clustering of sovereign credit rating downgrades in timing relative to the steepest phase of Fed rate hikes
Highlight the relationship between external-debt-to-GDP levels and the magnitude of local currency depreciation across the 8 countries

Map countries to grouped or faceted panels, use bar/dot encodings for debt-to-GDP and depreciation, overlay the Fed rate as a shared timeline reference, and encode rating changes with directional symbols or color shifts
